summary: Draft docs after the amendment: the API note and ADR-0005 now also cover refusing other URL shorteners (reason URL_SHORTENER).

# Abuse protection

## Refused destinations: `POST /api/v1/links`
| Status | Problem | When |
|---|---|---|
| `400` | `/problems/invalid-url`, `reason: BLOCKED_DOMAIN` | the host is on `shortener.abuse.blocked-domains`, or a subdomain of one |
| `400` | `/problems/invalid-url`, `reason: URL_SHORTENER` | the host is another URL shortener (`shortener.abuse.shortener-domains`, by default bit.ly, tinyurl.com, t.co, goo.gl, ow.ly, is.gd, buff.ly, rebrand.ly, cutt.ly, shorturl.at) |

Matching is by domain and subdomain, case-insensitively: `www.evil.test` matches `evil.test`, and
`notevil.test` does not. No external service is called.

## Flagging: `POST /api/v1/admin/links/{code}/flag`
Only API keys named in `shortener.abuse.admin-keys` may flag. Idempotent.

| Status | Problem | When |
|---|---|---|
| `204` | | flagged (or already flagged) |
| `401` | `/problems/unauthorized` | no or unknown API key |
| `403` | `/problems/forbidden` | the key is not an admin key |
| `404` | `/problems/link-not-found` | unknown or deleted link |

```
curl -X POST http://localhost:8085/api/v1/admin/links/abc1234/flag -H "X-API-Key: $ADMIN_KEY"
```

## Redirect of a flagged link: `GET /{code}`
`451` with `/problems/link-unavailable`, from the next request on (the cache is evicted when the flag
commits). The owner sees `status: FLAGGED` on `GET /api/v1/links/{code}`.

# ADR-0005: Abuse protection by destination rules and admin flagging

- **Status:** Accepted
- **Scope:** `shortener-service`, packages `abuse`, `url` and `link`

## Context
"Make the shortener safer" was too vague to build. The answers narrowed it to malicious destination
URLs: block known-bad domains when a link is created, let an admin stop existing abusive links, call
no external API and rescan nothing.

## Decision
- **Rules run in `UrlValidator`**, which every create already calls. Hosts are matched by domain and
  subdomain against configuration, never by substring.
- **Links may not point at other URL shorteners.** A chain hides the real destination from these
  checks, and following it would mean outbound requests at create time. The common public
  shorteners are refused by default (`shortener.abuse.shortener-domains`).
- **Flagging is a status**, `FLAGGED` (Flyway V3 widens the check constraint). A flagged link answers
  `451 Unavailable For Legal Reasons` and is never cached; the flag evicts L1 and L2 after it commits.
- **Admins are API keys listed by name** (`shortener.abuse.admin-keys`); there is no new login.

## Consequences
- No new dependency or network call; the create path stays fast and testable.
- Other instances' L1 can still redirect a just-flagged link for up to 5 minutes (the BF-1 window).
- Rolling back needs flagged rows unflagged first: the old constraint rejects `FLAGGED`.
